newsitem.title: SPAIN: Madrid stocks nudge down, consolidation continues.
newsitem.headline: Madrid stocks nudge down, consolidation continues.

text.p: MADRID, July 18 (Reuter) 0840 GMT - Madrid shares were lower in early trade on Friday in a continued consolidation process tracking other European bourses, dealer said.

Underlying sentiment was still positive, but the market needed to take a breather, they said. All eyes were on the expiry of July futures, adding an element of caution. * General index down 1.91 points, 0.31 percent, to 616.41 * Ibex down 13.06 points, 0.19 percent, to 7,021.72 * Support at around 7,000 for the Ibex expected to hold * Losses broad based. Telefonica off 15 pesetas to 4,300, BBV down 100 pesetas to 13,060 after renewed recent strength ahead of results and share split.

"Although the underlying feeling is positive, we expect a summer of consolidation, with the (Ibex) 7,200 level holding, although 7,000 (support) should stay intact. We're not expecting a big correction, but the market should start to get calmer now," said a dealer at Benito y Monjardin brokerage.
In any case, movements will continue to be led by the performance of the dollar and Wall Street in the absence of specific company news, he added.
